1.mascotDialogue: Extract-max's really two moves — swap the root with the last leaf, shrink the heap by one, then let that displaced value sink to wherever she truly belongs.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 4 and 5 find the biggest of the node and her two kids. Line 8's recursive call — that's what lets the displaced value keep sinking, past more than one level, if she's gotta.

3.mascotDialogue: 9 sits up top, and every parent beats both her kids, all the way down. Same array-index maths as min heap — just the comparison's flipped.

4.mascotDialogue: The swap alone doesn't finish the job, mate. Without siftDown, you've just relocated the problem up to the top of the tree — not solved a thing.
